name: Garnier Hair Conditioner Aloe Vera
description: Explore the nourishing & hydrating benefits of using Fructis Hair Food Aloe Vera Shampoo & Conditioner for dry hair. With aloe vera's powerful hydrating & cleansing properties, you'll see results after just one use as your hair receives up to 8X more moisture. This formulation is silicone-free, free from artificial colorants, & is both cruelty-free & vegan, making it the perfect addition to your aloe vera hair care routine.
